en: A colorized vintage postcard view over a lush, tree‑covered coastal settlement. In the foreground are gardens and wooden houses behind a fence. To the left rises a large white Orthodox church with multiple green onion domes. In the background lies a broad body of water with small islands, boats, and industrial chimneys along the far shore. At the top right is red printed text reading "N.-Jõesuu. Hungerburg."
